headline: California: new authority over AI or data centers for a government body
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

California gives the Department of Motor Vehicles the power to demand quarterly crash and response-time data from autonomous vehicle manufacturers, starting July 1, 2028. Passed.

13 measures in ten states would have an AI service check the identity or age of the people who use it.

91 measures in 29 jurisdictions cite the fear that data centers are taking the power and the water.

2,235 measures tracked. 752 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 102 offices.
